idea.description: Train one attribute-sensitive HSTU per category, jointly learning item-ID and lightweight title/description representations. Evaluate a filtered uniform-negative control against a prespecified warm-start followed by a conservative mixture of uniform and stochastic TF-IDF-neighbor negatives, using one learned scoring function and checkpoint per category.
idea.motivation: Address two observed user failures: broad associations replacing specific preferences, and recommendations overlooking explicit format/connector distinctions. Also test the measured Electronics negative-over-positive rate of 10.71%, negative 10th-percentile margin of -0.0749, and small-margin rate of 16.36%. These measurements support a discrimination hypothesis, not a demonstrated held-out improvement. Text provides uncertain attribute evidence; neither purchase histories nor timestamps establish satisfaction, fulfilled needs or physical compatibility. The revised originality/potential/difficulty scores are 5/7/6 because the components are established, transfer is uncertain, and reproducible sampling, controls and deployment require substantial care.

Extend the supplied corrected HSTU without replacing its backbone. Preserve preprocessing seed 0, training seed 42, DATA_DIR = os.environ['GAGC_DATA_DIR'], trial-local artifacts, all four routes, supplied splits, maximum 200 epochs and exactly 200 batches per executed epoch. Train sequentially on one GPU; record all training, diagnostics and failed-run GPU seconds against the shared 43,200-second budget. No pretrained weights, external datasets, hidden test files, other-trial checkpoints or separately fitted inference scores are permitted.

Construct text assets only from host-permitted titles/descriptions. Do not use the generic example's unavailable reviews, ratings, prices, stores or item categories. Use deterministic lowercase tokenization that preserves internal digits, decimals, hyphens and slashes, including 3.5mm, USB-C and DVD-Audio, and preserves direction words as tokens. Encode title and description separately, truncating to 32 and 96 tokens respectively. Reserve PAD=0 and UNK=1; retain tokens appearing in at least two permitted item documents, cap vocabulary at 50,000, and order by descending document frequency with lexical tie-breaking. These are proposed reproducible defaults. Record the tokenizer pattern, metadata scope, truncation and vocabulary in the checkpoint. Use a 32-dimensional token embedding, masked mean within each field, concatenate the two field vectors and project to the baseline item dimension. Set item_vector(i) = item_emb(i) + sigmoid(g) * LayerNorm(project(text_i)), with one learned scalar g initialized to -3. Force the residual to zero for missing text and item 0. Keep input/output item representations tied to this same jointly learned representation. No independent text predictor is fitted.

Pooling preserves token identity but loses order and number-unit bindings. Consequently, the method targets learnable distinctions rather than guaranteeing connector direction or compatibility. An optional later ablation replaces pooling with width-2/3/5 CNN filters, masking padded windows and pooling only valid outputs. Match its trainable capacity when comparing against the mean encoder. Character n-grams are a deferred option for rare identifiers, not part of the primary specification; introducing them requires a separately documented ablation.

Build static TF-IDF neighbors from the same truncated text using the recorded tokenizer, raw token counts, idf=log((1+N)/(1+df))+1 and L2 normalization. Exclude self-neighbors, zero-similarity entries and padding; retain up to 100 neighbors, sorted by descending cosine and ascending item ID for ties. Use sparse, chunked retrieval rather than materializing an N-by-N matrix. TF-IDF supplies training proposals only; it never contributes an inference score. Neighbor construction time/storage and GPU mining/scoring time must be logged.

For each valid supervised position, independently sample 128 unique negatives. For the curriculum, set neighbor probability to 0 through epoch 20, 0.25*(epoch-20)/40 during epochs 21–60, and 0.25 thereafter. For each draw, choose uniform catalog sampling or a uniform draw from the target item's stored neighbor list. Reject padding, the target, every item in that user's complete observed training history, and previously selected negatives. Do not consult validation or test histories for exclusions. After 32 failed attempts for a slot, sample uniformly from the remaining eligible catalog; if fewer than 128 eligible items exist, use all eligible items and mask unused slots. Apply identical exclusions, uniqueness, fallback and negative count to the uniform control. This differs deliberately from the official replacement sampler; do not describe it as an exact replication. Use a dedicated seeded sampling generator, with deterministic worker seeding, and retain family-specific sample_batch behavior for causal sequence construction. The host diagnosis loader's four-tuple remains unchanged; carry any training-only user identity needed for exclusions through an internal sampler interface.

Compute logits as cosine(feature, item_vector)/0.05 and optimize cross-entropy with the positive explicitly included once. Apply this objective only at valid nonpadding supervised positions and average those losses. This is an uncorrected contrastive objective, not an unbiased estimate of full-catalog softmax. User filtering and sampling without replacement invalidate naïve -log(128q) corrections. Score negatives in chunks if required; chunking must preserve each position's complete denominator and gradients. Complexity is O(P*128*d) for P supervised positions. A shared negative pool changes correlations and is outside the primary comparison. Hold the corrected baseline optimizer, learning-rate schedule, HSTU width/depth, dropout and sequence length fixed unless a separately reported experiment changes them. If the corrected baseline already uses any proposed component, mark that component as present rather than claiming it as a new ablation.

Prespecify comparisons: corrected baseline; normalized 128-uniform objective without text; text residual with the original objective; curriculum without text under the normalized objective; and the proposed full combination. Use targeted removals to resolve interactions only if the budget permits. Normalization, temperature, negative count, text and sampling can interact; do not attribute a combined improvement to one component. An immediate-neighbor control can distinguish warm-start effects from simply adding hard negatives, at matched proposal/scoring cost. Sampling objectives already emphasize difficult negatives, making overlap with temperature effects plausible. Never launch an ablation that cannot fit the remaining budget; report omitted controls and every attempted configuration.

Preserve the host's validation schedule and checkpoint rule, specifying its actual settings in the experiment manifest before training. If the baseline supplies no checkpoint tie rule, prefer the earliest checkpoint among equal macro validation HR@10 values. The independently pinned host evaluator remains authoritative. Keep candidate sets and evaluation seed 42 unchanged. Do not select on Electronics alone or on diagnostic margins. With 200 users/category, one changed user hit changes macro HR@10 by 0.125 percentage points. If per-user validation hits are available, use paired within-category bootstrap resampling with 10,000 replicates and a dedicated analysis RNG seed 42; average the four category means in each replicate. Report percentile 95% intervals and discordant-user counts. These intervals condition on training seed and sampled candidates and do not remove optimism from repeated validation selection. Budget permitting, train a capacity-matched ID-only control, a text-length/missingness-only control, and a shuffled-text control. Do not claim to measure a true false-negative rate.

Keep DiagnosisProbe(view, device), run_full_diagnosis(train_loader), diagnosis_interpreter_prompt(raw_diagnosis), view.model as the actual trained module, and the host ModelView contracts. Record negative-score quantiles and observed-positive proposal rejection rates; record gradient concentration only with an explicit definition and affordable instrumentation. Unavailable category breakdowns remain empty/unavailable rather than inferred from unsupported metadata. The interpretation prompt must use measured values and their definitions.

Use the maximum position index whose item is nonzero for left-padded readout, never nonpadding_count-1; handle an entirely empty sequence explicitly using the baseline convention. Save one selected checkpoint/category containing learned parameters, architecture configuration, vocabulary, tokenizer, token tensors and missing-text masks. Training-only neighbor assets need not load at inference. Update the embedded predictor writer with the identical model definition, normalization, temperature, text fusion and routing. Verify that training and reloaded predictor scores agree on the same permitted example before accepting a trial.                 Retain internal user IDs for training-history negative exclusions.
                If normalized objective is enabled:

                        p_neighbor = 0 if uniform control else curriculum_probability(epoch)
                        Draw up to 128 unique negatives using the specified mixture.
                        Reject padding, target and complete observed training-history items.
                        Apply bounded-retry uniform fallback and mask unavailable slots.

                    logits = cosine(features, joint_item_vectors) / 0.05
                    loss = mean_valid_position_cross_entropy(positive_once, negatives)

originality.negative: The components and curriculum principles are established; novelty lies mainly in the benchmark adaptation and controlled integration.

future_potential.positive: Offers a reusable experimental path for determining whether observable item details improve discrimination beyond broad historical associations.
future_potential.negative: Sparse text, unordered pooling, false negatives and sampled-evaluation limitations may restrict transfer; no improvement has been measured.

code_difficulty.positive: A small text residual and static training proposals preserve the HSTU backbone and avoid extra inference models.
code_difficulty.negative: Per-position filtered sampling, efficient scoring, deterministic text assets, shortcut controls and exact checkpoint/predictor parity require substantial implementation and verification.

idea_diagnosis.description: Strengthen the paired temporal-sensitivity diagnostic for the supplied HSTU ModelView adapter with identity controls, final-event-preserving interventions, explicit coordinate-confounding checks, and dependence-aware reporting. Hold each original positive/negative pair fixed across interventions and interpret results as sensitivity measurements rather than evidence of user intent or expected accuracy gains.
idea_diagnosis.motivation: Existing embedding and margin diagnostics cannot distinguish recent-event dependence, broader ordering effects, or artifacts caused by repacking histories. Qualitative feedback motivates investigating these distinctions, but no supplied evidence establishes that increasing or decreasing perturbation sensitivity improves validation HR@10. This audit should generate hypotheses for subsequent controlled single-model HSTU ablations, without assuming ownership, satisfied needs, compatibility, or unobserved simulator traits.

Preserve view.model as the trained module and the item_emb, log2feats(sequence), predict_score(features, items), user_train, meta_data, and review_data contracts. Use evaluation mode and no_grad, restoring the original mode in finally. Cache at most ten batches; record batch, row, valid-position and eligibility counts. Use local seed-42 randomness and five deterministic permutation/deletion replicates, reporting their count. Do not imply that loader rows are unique users.

Before attributing effects, document the supplied backbone's actual timestamp inputs, relative and absolute position representations, attention masks, aggregation scaling, and normalization. The HSTU reference implementation uses next-position timestamp anchors with endpoint handling, but this does not establish the supplied baseline's behavior. The sequence-only compatibility interface does not establish access to timestamps or arbitrary coordinate masks. If these are unavailable, mark coordinate-controlled and time-specific probes unavailable and describe ordinary deletion as a combined information-and-repacking intervention. Never fabricate timestamps or infer that a sequence-only perturbation isolates time.

Locate each original final nonpadding position with masked position indices. Exclude empty sequences or zero positive/negative targets and report reasons. Freeze that position's original target pair across all interventions. Score original and perturbed final representations using features B x 1 x D and candidates B x 1 x 2 where required by the adapter. For histories of length n >= 3, delete k = max(1, floor(0.2*(n-1))) events from the prefix: its oldest k, most recent k, or k uniformly sampled positions. Preserve the final event in all three conditions. Separately compare removal of the final and penultimate events for n >= 2. These contrasts have different interpretations and must remain separately labeled. Repack retained events with left padding, holding input tensor length fixed. Always extract the altered sequence's actual final nonpadding feature.

For order probes, preserve length, padding, final item and item multiset. Include full-prefix shuffling, adjacent-pair swaps within the prefix, and shuffling before a preserved suffix of min(3, n-1) events; mark cases with fewer than two permutable events ineligible. Preserve chronological timestamp slots for item-only permutations if timestamps exist. Joint item–timestamp permutations are optional, separately labeled nonchronological stress tests. Identity perturbations must reproduce original scores within declared numerical tolerances, for example atol=1e-5 and rtol=1e-4, with deviations reported.

When backbone instrumentation permits, evaluate identical retained-event subsets under preserved original coordinates and ordinary compaction. Preserve original temporal query anchors explicitly; retaining timestamps alone is insufficient. Fully exclude deleted slots as attention keys and queries and from normalization, while holding tensor length, scaling, candidate pairs and readout conventions fixed. Gathering original relative/time-bias submatrices for compacted sequences is an optional additional control, but absolute embeddings and other coordinate-dependent paths must also be handled. Internal holes can introduce distribution shift, so these contrasts still do not establish causal preference effects. Instrumented identity inference must match ordinary inference before using the control.

Retain embedding geometry diagnostics and training-pair separation metrics. Return raw margins, positive-minus-negative margin changes, negative-wins rates, pairwise-order flips, and feature cosine similarities with explicit denominators. Define small margins as below 0.5 while warning that the threshold is scale-dependent. Use null plus a reason for unavailable measurements, empty samples, or undefined cosine similarities. Item-category breakdowns are unavailable because task metadata excludes those attributes. Use only public histories, timestamps, titles and descriptions; do not access ratings, review text, prices, stores or item categories.

Loader diagnostics cannot calculate validation HR@10. If the authorized host supplies paired fixed-candidate evaluation, retain its users, targets, 99 unique negatives, eligibility rules and seed across interventions; report per-category and macro HR@10 changes, target-rank changes and top-10 overlap. Do not replace the host evaluator or its unperturbed model-selection score. Aggregate repeated histories and intervention replicates within each user before uncertainty estimation; with verified identities, bootstrap users within categories using 1,000 seed-42 resamples and report percentile 95% intervals. Without identities, provide descriptive summaries and explicitly omit user-level intervals. These intervals are conditional on the fitted model and fixed candidates, not training-seed uncertainty.

The interpretation prompt must embed actual measurements, definitions, counts and missingness, distinguish input sensitivity from preference or improvement claims, and avoid numerical uplift forecasts. Predeclare a small subsequent ablation sequence rather than repeatedly mining diagnostics and validation feedback. Select any training change solely by the pinned four-category macro validation HR@10. The diagnostic proposal requires no retraining or predictor change; any later architecture change must update checkpoint serialization and the embedded predictor writer together. Retain DATA_DIR = os.environ['GAGC_DATA_DIR'], trial-local artifacts, preprocessing seed 0, training seed 42, maximum 200 epochs, 200 batches per epoch, all four routes, single-GPU execution and the shared search budget. Each category must load exactly one independently trained HSTU checkpoint, without independently fitted score fusion or checkpoint averaging.

audit = document_actual_hstu_paths_and_supported_controls(view)
was_training = view.model.training
view.model.eval()
try:
  with no_grad():
    for batch_id, (_, seq, pos, neg) in enumerate(first_ten_cached_batches):
      end = last_nonpadding_index_using_masked_positions(seq)
      eligible = nonempty_sequence_and_nonzero_targets(seq, pos, neg, end)
      candidates = original_targets_at_end(pos, neg, end)
      original_features = final_nonpadding_feature(view.log2feats(seq), seq)
      original_scores = score_via_modelview(original_features, candidates)
      record_identity_check(seq, original_scores, atol=1e-5, rtol=1e-4)
      plans = deterministic_intervention_plans(seq, seed=42, replicates=5)
      # Prefix deletions share k and preserve the final event.
      # Final and penultimate deletions are separate matched conditions.
      # Prefix permutations preserve declared suffixes and the item multiset.
      for plan in plans:
        altered, intervention_eligible = apply_and_left_pad(seq, plan)
        features = final_nonpadding_feature(view.log2feats(altered), altered)
        scores = score_via_modelview(features, candidates)
        record_paired_metrics(original_scores, scores,
                              original_features, features,
                              eligible & intervention_eligible,
                              batch_id, plan)
        if plan.is_deletion and audit.supports_coordinate_control:
          controlled_scores = score_same_retained_subset_with_original_coordinates(
              view, seq, plan, candidates,
              preserve_query_time_anchors=True,
              exclude_deleted_keys_queries_and_normalization=True)
          record_coordinate_contrast(scores, controlled_scores, plan)
        elif plan.is_deletion:
          record_unavailable_coordinate_control(audit.reason)
    metrics = summarize_counts_missingness_and_paired_effects()
    # Aggregate by verified user IDs before bootstrap; otherwise descriptive only.
    attach_user_intervals_only_if_identity_mapping_is_verified(metrics)
    return {'metrics': metrics,
            'metric_definitions': definitions_with_scope_and_confounding_limits()}
finally:
  view.model.train(was_training)

# definitions, eligibility and missingness; it requests hypothesis generation
# without causal, compatibility, or expected-validation-uplift claims.
# Paired validation ranks/HR@10 require authorized host evaluation separately.

The best initial experiment remains **attribute-sensitive HSTU with a conservative negative curriculum**, evaluated through staged ablations. It targets broad-but-unspecific recommendations and overlooked format/connector distinctions, while testing Electronics’ measured separation weakness. Improvements remain hypotheses.

**Insights from the starting point.** (1) Electronics negatives beat positives at 10.71% of measured positions; discrimination is a concrete intervention target. These training diagnostics do not establish validation ranking quality. (2) Similarity scores near 0.5 imply average cosine near zero; collapse regularization lacks support. Centered spectra could reveal other representation deficiencies. (3) Users report insufficient specificity and compatibility mismatches. Available text offers partial evidence, not reliable proof of compatibility or fulfilled needs.

**Insights from related work.** (1) Official HSTU uses normalized sampled cross-entropy with 128 per-position negatives and temperature 0.05 [1]. Its replacement sampling differs from the proposed filtered, unique sampler. (2) R²NS motivates gradual hardening [2], while HDCCF highlights false-negative risks [8]. Neither establishes this adaptation’s benefit. (3) MARS motivates attribute-sensitive matching [3].     """Training-history exclusions and unique negatives at each supervised position.

    This implements the uniform control only. No text assets, neighbor curriculum,
    independently fitted scores, or additional predictors are introduced.

            user: np.asarray(
                sorted({int(i) for i in items if 1 <= int(i) <= itemnum}),
                dtype=np.int64,
            )
            for user, items in user_train.items()

        self.fallback_rng = np.random.default_rng(42)

            [min(NUM_NEGATIVES, self.itemnum - len(h)) for h in histories],
            device=self.device,
        )

            0

                generator=self.generator,

class HSTUBlock(nn.Module):
    """A compact HSTU-style block: causal attention + SiLU gates + residual FFN."""

    def __init__(self, hidden_units: int, num_heads: int, dropout_rate: float):
        super().__init__()
        self.norm = nn.LayerNorm(hidden_units)
        self.attn = nn.MultiheadAttention(
            hidden_units,
            num_heads,
            dropout=dropout_rate,
            batch_first=True,
        )
        self.gate = nn.Linear(hidden_units, hidden_units * 2)
        self.dropout = nn.Dropout(dropout_rate)
        self.ffn_norm = nn.LayerNorm(hidden_units)
        self.ffn = nn.Sequential(
            nn.Linear(hidden_units, hidden_units * 4),
            nn.SiLU(),
            nn.Dropout(dropout_rate),
            nn.Linear(hidden_units * 4, hidden_units),
            nn.Dropout(dropout_rate),
        )

    def forward(
        self,
        seq_emb: torch.Tensor,
        causal_mask: torch.Tensor,
        padding_mask: torch.Tensor,
    ) -> torch.Tensor:
        normed = self.norm(seq_emb)
        attn_out, _ = self.attn(
            normed,
            normed,
            normed,
            attn_mask=causal_mask,
            key_padding_mask=padding_mask,
            need_weights=False,
        )
        value, gate = self.gate(attn_out).chunk(2, dim=-1)
        seq_emb = seq_emb + self.dropout(value * F.silu(gate))
        seq_emb = seq_emb + self.ffn(self.ffn_norm(seq_emb))
        return seq_emb
